outputs.explanation: Panel A is a scatter plot with marginal histograms showing rhythmicity index vs. period; no significance symbols (e.g., asterisks, ns, p-values) appear on the plot or are referenced in the caption.
Panel B is a scatter plot of noise vs. circadian component with error bars; no statistical significance symbols are present on the image or mentioned in the caption.
Panel C shows density distributions (histogram-like curves) of period and amplitude by subtype; no significance symbols are used.
Panel D is a boxplot of CWT ridge lengths with individual data points; no significance testing symbols (asterisks, ns, etc.) are shown or referenced.
Panel E consists of polar histograms of phase differences; no significance symbols appear.
Panel F is a polar histogram of subtype-averaged phase differences; no significance symbols appear.
Panel G is an illustrative fitted signal trace (example of curve fitting), not a statistical comparison; no significance symbols are present.
Panel H is a scatter plot of amplitude vs. decay rate with error bars and a coupling-strength color scale; no significance symbols are shown or referenced in the caption.
